descriptions.before: PowerScale capacity — per hardware pool: total, used %, and usable TB computed AFTER the virtual hot spare reservation (avail_bytes alone overstates free space, 36x on one pool here), plus per-path QUOTA pressure: used vs hard/soft thresholds, exceeded flags, and bytes-per-file (logical bytes / inodes — separates a large-file workload from a small-file one when nothing else does). A quota full and a filesystem full present identical symptoms; this returns the raw numbers that tell them apart. Fleet by default, cluster= narrows. Use for 'how full', 'usable space', 'quota status', 'which quotas are over'.
descriptions.after: PowerScale capacity — per cluster (capacity_by_cluster: total, used, used %, usable TB, the figures for 'how full is it') and per hardware pool: total, used %, and usable TB computed AFTER the virtual hot spare reservation (avail_bytes alone overstates free space, 36x on one pool here), plus per-path QUOTA pressure: used vs hard/soft thresholds, exceeded flags, and bytes-per-file (logical bytes / inodes — separates a large-file workload from a small-file one when nothing else does). A quota full and a filesystem full present identical symptoms; this returns the raw numbers that tell them apart. Fleet by default, cluster= narrows. Use for 'how full', 'usable space', 'quota status', 'which quotas are over'.

cluster.description: cluster name or any fragment — omit for the fleet
